target_customer: Internal and external audit teams at large companies
problem: Audits involve repetitive document review and discrepancy hunting. Tergle builds custom AI agents that analyze pages of data and flag discrepancies for auditors.
business_model: Custom-built AI solutions for audit teams with onboarding and ongoing support; pricing by sales call

founders.name: Adam Bowen
education: Left college at 17 to move to Tokyo
previous_startups: EdTech non-profit co-built at 16, scaled to 500+ partner schools in the UK
founders.background_notes: YC page says his father is an internal auditor, which inspired the company.

founders.name: William Tarr
previous_startups: EdTech non-profit co-built with Adam Bowen
founders.background_notes: YC page gives only the first name William and says he met Adam at school in England; surname from RuntimeWire.

competitors.name: DataSnipper
competitors.traction_then: company claims more than 400,000 users in 125 countries in a 2024 release

competitors.name: Fieldguide
competitors.what: AI-native audit and advisory workflow platform
competitors.traction_then: claims use by over 50 of the top 100 audit and advisory firms (undated vendor claim); extended to financial audits in June 2024

competitors.name: MindBridge
competitors.what: AI transaction analysis for audit risk

technical_complexity.rationale: Custom agents over client documents use frontier models and integrations; accuracy and auditor trust are the hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Custom tailoring and Slack support create service lock-in, but several established audit tools were already adding AI.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; later 2025 and 2026 reports show many other AI audit startups raising money.

market_need_then: Audit is repetitive and document heavy, the founder's father is an internal auditor, and the company claims it works with multiple unnamed billion-dollar companies.

identity.voice_and_tone: confident, direct and action oriented, with punchy headlines such as Your AI-powered Auditor

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand found other than a RuntimeWire profile; the invented name carries no meaning for audit.

outcome_analysis: Tergle is an active early team from Winter 2025 building custom AI agents for auditors. No outcome event or verified funding beyond YC was found. It claims big enterprise customers but the claim is unverified, and competitors in AI audit were established or well funded, so the outlook is unproven.
notes: Aggregators claim about 500K USD total (VCBacked: Pre-Seed in Mar 2025 from YC, Pioneer Fund, Blockchain Founders Capital; ZoomInfo: 2025-01-31; Caplight: seed on 2025-02-27) with conflicting dates and stages; no primary source, so unverified and not recorded as a round. Competitor sources are 2024 and later trade articles; Fieldguide and DataSnipper figures are vendor-reported. Co-founder surname William Tarr comes from RuntimeWire, not the YC page. Completeness pass: the roughly 500K round is recorded from ZoomInfo as the source, with year only because dates conflict (2025-01-31 ZoomInfo, 2025-02-27 Caplight, 2025-03 VCBacked, 2025-05 Premier Alts) and stage labels differ. It rests on aggregators only; no press release found.
